description: CSR Insight — tables most relevant to the in-app chatbot (live data comes from Flask/SQLAlchemy, not from this file). DB engine: MySQL.
chatbot_data_policy: The LLM never runs SQL. Aggregates and samples are built server-side with permission and site scope applied first.

users.description: Platform users; JWT identifies the current user for chat.

columns.is_corporate_global: Corporate visibility across sites when applicable

sites.description: Industrial / legal sites for CSR scope.

columns.name: Display name (used to match user phrases like a country or plant name)

user_sites.description: Site users assigned to specific sites.

user_permissions.description: Optional per-user resource/action keys for corporate users.

csr_plans.description: Annual CSR plan per site and year.

planned_activity.description: Planned CSR activities (lines under a plan).

columns.title: Activity title
columns.status: Workflow field in DB (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, …). For validated/locked plans the API adds effective_status (PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, UNDER_REVIEW, …).
columns.edition_year: Calendar year of the edition (Excel column Year); not the same as csr_plans.year

realized_activity.description: Executed activity rows (saisie réalisée), linked to planned_activity.

documents.description: Uploaded files; site_id set when linked to a site.

audit_logs.description: Audit trail entries for compliance review.
